remarks_1999: Double entries Downtown Gallery Archive. Pictured in 1935 New York (An American Place) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 58. Reproduced and titled *From the Lake*, in *The Chicago Evening Post* (March 1926); *Under Water, Lake George* in *New York Herald Tribune* (January 1935); *Abstraction No. 3* in *Meeting of East and West* (1947). (Source: Lynes, 1999)
